follow-up time: Variable, up to discharge from the neonatal intensive care unit
cohort: 210 preterm neonates admitted to the neonatal intensive care units of three hospitals in Ethiopia
finding: The study found a significant delay in initiating trophic feeding among preterm neonates, with several factors such as lower gestational age, lower APGAR score, and presence of complications like respiratory distress syndrome contributing to the delay.
mod_finding: Cesarean section delivery was associated with a delay in initiating trophic feeding.
